bsh

Interface BshLambda.Wrapper

  • Enclosing class:
    BshLambda

    public static interface BshLambda.Wrapper
    Implemented by every generated wrapper class. A wrapper for a scripted interface is GeneratedClass-assignable without being a script-generated class, so Reflect must be able to tell the two apart.
